raw.bbox_semantics: corner_xywh; finite positive size, no clipping to image bounds
raw.coordinate_space: official resized image metadata; OOD RGB resize to1920x1080 before pose alignment
raw.joint_valid: finite XY and score>=0.2, nonzero XY; pelvis uses hips11/12, shoulders5/6
raw.torso: shoulder midpoint minus pelvis; length sqrt(dx_norm^2+dy_norm^2), >1e-8
raw.invalid: zero + explicit channel mask, no interpolation, no sequence removal

causal.smoothing: full-sequence trailing valid mean; valid if any valid in trailing3
causal.derivative: backward difference times25; valid only when adjacent operands valid; first value invalid zero
causal.feature_order: channel-major 12x5 level then12x5 velocity; pelvis_y acceleration4; quality7
causal.window_order: exact V3 sequence_index/window_start; no appended tail; derivative never reset per window

model.frozen: DSTE/ADL and final J1-V3; only new G heads optimized
model.global_scaler: train-only mean/population_std float64, scale<1e-12 set1; J1 unscaled

training.class_weight: train-only inverse-sqrt counts normalized by mean; absent count clamp1
training.shuffle: CPU torch.Generator seed+epoch, same order for G0/G1/G2, drop_last=false
training.selection: per-variant validation macroF1 then conditional fall-vs-lie AP; exact ties earliest epoch
training.holdout: test/ood features, labels and metrics only after selection lock; no retuning

audit.feature_rebuild: all windows; independent first/middle/last per sequence

newly_specified_not_recovered: SGD lr0.006 batch512 momentum0.9 and inverse-sqrt weights
per-head AP tie breaker and current finalJ1 lineage
singleGPU0 and resource-conscious in-memory J1 representations
